entries.title: Chaos Legion
entries.definitive_edition: Retail Windows PC release with community/compatibility fixes available.

emulation.emulator: Native Windows PC; PCSX2 for the PS2 version
emulation.notes: Try the Windows version first with compatibility fixes. Use PCSX2 for an owned PS2 copy if the old PC version is impractical.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation if compatibility fixes work; otherwise original PS2 presentation with emulator-side improvements.

primary.version: Retail Windows PC release with community/compatibility fixes available.
primary.why: Chaos Legion shipped on PS2 and Windows; the Windows release is the highest-fidelity route because it is a native PC version, though it may require compatibility fixes on modern systems.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Windows PC copy and apply compatibility guidance as needed. Use the PS2 version through PCSX2 if the old PC release is not practical.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, or current digital rerelease was identified.
